author: TEDx Talks
description: In this talk, Ismail El Omari shares his journey of reconnecting with a childhood dream of becoming part of the world of space exploration. After choosing a conventional path as an architect, he discovered that passion does not disappear but waits patiently to be embraced again. His story gently reminds us that the dreams we once carried may still be guiding us toward who we are meant to become. Ismail El Omari is a Moroccan architect, analog astronaut, and space advocate based in Agadir. He is co-founder and president of the Moroccan Association for Space Studies, promoting space education for youth. Ismail was the first Moroccan to join an Analog Mars mission, focusing on isolation and teamwork. Through his work and talks, he inspires young people to dream boldly and pursue extraordinary journeys. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Becoming who I was(n't) Supposed to Be  | Ismail EL Omari | TEDxUIR

description:
Et si la peur n’était que passagère ?

Oser, même en étant imparfait vaut toujours mieux que renoncer par crainte d’échouer ou de décevoir. 

Ce talk invite à ne plus laisser la peur décider à notre place, à oser malgré le doute et l’inconfort.

Car ce ne sont pas nos échecs qui nous poursuivent, mais les occasions que nous n’avons jamais osé saisir. Fondatrice de Mezyan At Work et experte en risques psychosociaux et qualité de vie et conditions de travail.
